column_semantics: The schedule has a 'Reference Rate and Spread' column and a separate 'Interest Rate (2)' column. For PIK loans, the printed spread is a single all-in spread with the PIK component shown parenthetically as included, e.g. 'S + 7.00 % (incl. 2.00 % PIK)'; the 'Interest Rate (2)' column then shows the current all-in rate in effect, not a cash-only rate.

rationale: The printed schedule does not present separate cash and PIK columns and does not append PIK as an additive amount outside the stated spread. Instead, each PIK example prints the PIK component parenthetically as included in the stated spread, while note (2) says the schedule provides the reference rate, spread, and interest rate in effect. Therefore the stated position-level rate/spread is all-in, with PIK included.
